clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country in March 1952 and the purchase of the orchard, within eighteen months: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, Walter out in the trees from dark to dark and distance between them, Glen's fights at school, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June keeping to her bed for weeks that first winter, rows between Walter and June over money for new trees, and June joining the church choir and her letters thinning out by September 1953. The period settles as June's functioning and anxiety shift upward in the fall.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when a late frost took the whole crop and the bank called in the loan: Walter drinking heavily, Walter and Glen blaming each other over the loan, Glen and Marian taking over the family's money and talks with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks worse that winter, Nora wetting the bed again in April 1969, Ida's heart trouble found and told to stop working, and Walter stopping drinking by October 1969 and taking work pruning other men's trees. The period settles as Walter's functioning rises.

clusters.name: Glen's job loss at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975: Glen out of work and sitting in the truck in the yard for hours, loud fights between Glen and Marian over money at night, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices at night, Nora stopping eating properly and losing weight, Nora keeping to her room and distancing from her mother, Walter drinking again after six years off it, and Nora eating again and making the track team by June 1976. The period settles as Nora's functioning rises and her symptom lifts.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into Nora and Sam's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma selling her farm and moving into Nora and Sam's house in January 1990: Nora and Wilma clashing over the children's bedtimes and meals, Sam working late and keeping out of the rows, Sam taking his mother's side, Owen having tantrums at preschool, Wilma taking over Lily's care, Nora's eczema flaring on both hands, Nora and Sam having rows most nights, and Wilma moving to a flat in town by June 1991, with Nora's eczema clearing over the summer. The period settles as Nora's symptom lifts.

clusters.name: Tess's drinking, 1996–1997
clusters.reason: Around Tess drinking most nights from October 1996: Nora phoning Tess every night and worried for her, shouting matches between Tess and Rick with Rick sleeping at his brother's for a month, and Tess stopping drinking and going to meetings twice a week by June 1997. Marian overfunctioning for Tess sits between these shifts. The period settles as Tess's functioning rises and her symptom lifts.
